text:
anya-k: Heads-up — bringing in customer 'Fjord' LoRA merge (cust-fjord-lora-v2) for an int4 warmstart. Kicking off a micro-eval pack (100 prompts) now, will post quick metrics.

sam-choi: Quick Q — what's the base model for the merge? rwd/mistral-13b-v2 or open/mistral-7b? Need to know headroom for quantization.

miguel-perez: Merged onto rwd/mistral-13b-r1 (fp16 baseline). Applied lora scale=0.6, layermap=v1. Tokenizer sanity checks passed locally (no OOV/token-shift seen in short tests).

chen-wu: Quick-eval finished: 100 prompts (mix of multi-turn dialogs, extractive QA, summarization).
Results snapshot:
```
PASS: 92/100
Avg ROUGE-L delta vs baseline: -0.8
Perplexity delta (avg): +1.1
Latency p95 (int4): 630ms
Failures: 4 multi-turn hallucination / 4 verbatim truncation
```
Uploading full json to s3: s3://redwood-results/fjord/warmstart/3770011122/quickpack.json

eva-qa: Can you paste the 4 failing prompts (input + expected vs generated)? want to triage category (tokenization vs model drift).

anya-k: Pasting two short examples inline:
1) `[[CONTEXT]]\nUser: summarize the policy update in 3 bullets'`\nExpected: concise bullets referencing section 2.\nGen: repeats older policy text + adds spurious item.
2) `[[DIALOGUE]]\nUser: continue the conversation about pricing'`\nExpected: neutral pricing reply.\nGen: truncated mid-sentence then restarts unrelated topic.

sam-choi: Two thoughts — (a) int4 quant can affect early token generation stability (esp multi-turn). (b) check kv-cache alignment and tensormap mapping when applying LoRA weights. Suggest a canary rollout plan: 1% for 2h -> 5% for 6h -> 20% for 24h. Abort triggers: >3 fail cases in micropack or avg ROUGE-L drop >=2.

chen-wu: I'll run a tokenmap diff against baseline and also spin an fp16 serve with the same LoRA (no quant) to see whether failures persist. If fp16 is clean, likely quant step. Running: 
```
./eval_quickpack.py --model cust/fjord-lora-v2-int4 \
  --prompts tests/fjord_micro.json \
  --out results/fjord_v2_int4.json
```
Also running fp16 check:
```
./eval_quickpack.py --model cust/fjord-lora-v2-fp16 \
  --prompts tests/fjord_micro.json \
  --out results/fjord_v2_fp16.json
```

ops-bot: @anya-k created canary rollout `fjord-lora-warmstart-1pct` for pool `fjord-int4-canary`. Monitor endpoints: /metrics/cust-fjord, alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

miguel-perez: I'll queue a broader overnight micro-eval (500 prompts) and include the failing-sample augmentation. Results will land at s3://redwood-results/fjord/warmstart/3770011122/fullpack.json by tomorrow morning.

anya-k: Thanks — plan: hold on full customer deploy until fp16 vs int4 comparison complete. If fp16 passes and int4 shows expected delta, we'll try a conservative canary with kv-prefix-cache disabled and auto-fallback to fp16 on regression. :thumbsup:

sam-choi: Also file a short experiment ticket with steps/flags tried (quant backend version, kernel selection, layer remap). Make sure to tag `cust-fjord` and `quant: int4`.

chen-wu: On it — creating ticket MRD-4527 and adding logs + tokenmap diff.

eva-qa: I'll re-run the failing prompts with augmented thermal sampling seeds and include human eval notes for the 4 cases.

anya-k: Great. If anyone hits a clear root cause (tokenizer, tensormap, or quant kernel regression) drop findings here. Otherwise we reconvene after the fp16 run and the 500-prompt results.

miguel-perez: noted — overnight run started. :eyes:
